mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 4.0% signals a tightening monetary policy regime that increases discount rates on future corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.0%, or the average 20-day return in such periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4.0% signals tightening labor market conditions that increase wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting the Fed to maintain restrictive policy and suppressing equity valuations over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE < 4.0%, or the average return in such periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential construction permits above 1.25 million units per month signals strong household demand and confidence, which drives higher corporate revenues and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when HOUST > 1250.0, or the average 60-day return is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 100.0 (index base 2017=100) signals weakening manufacturing activity and economic contraction, which triggers risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100.0, or the average 5-day return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in both real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) and residential investment (RSAFS) indicates broad-based demand strength that supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising GDPC1 and RSAFS fails to produce positive 20-day SPX returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC between the interaction term and SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent rise in CPI inflation above 3.5% combined with a stable federal funds rate signals that inflation expectations are unanchored, prompting equity markets to price in higher long-term discount rates and negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 3.5% and FEDFUNDS <= 4.0%, or the interaction term fails to exhibit a Rank IC > 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and rise in payroll employment signals a labor market that is both tight and expanding, increasing wage pressures and corporate labor costs, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE < 4.3% and PAYEMS > 158500, or the interaction term has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP (GDPC1) above its 4-quarter moving average combined with rising residential construction (HOUST) indicates a strong and self-sustaining economic expansion, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances where GDPC1 > 4-quarter MA and HOUST > 1250.0, or the interaction term fails to achieve a Rank IC > 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
